Name: Questionable
Author: the Puni.sh Quest Squad
Description:
A tiny little quest helper plugin, which does quests for you automatically where possible. Uses navmesh to automatically walk to all quest waypoints, and tries to automatically complete all steps along the way.

Not all quests are supported, check the quest journal (/qst journal) for an updated list.

Required Plugins: vnavmesh, TextAdvance, Lifestream
